content: Not disabled: an account that owns a private room cannot be disabled. Change the owner of each of its private rooms first.

comment.text: Error toast in the accounts list, shown to an administrator after the Disable user dialog is confirmed and the server refuses because one of the selected accounts owns a private (end-to-end encrypted) room. Two sentences: what was not done, then what to do first, which is to change the owner of that account's private rooms. Disabled means the account is deactivated, not deleted; keep the term used for the Disable action of users.
